evals.prompt: 核实 README、SRS、追溯矩阵和设计文档是否与当前源码和测试一致，先只读审计。
evals.expected_output: Builds a claim-to-implementation matrix with current file:line and executable evidence.

evals.prompt: 核对这份修复记录是否准确描述当前工作树 diff、测试和文件数量，不要改文件。
evals.expected_output: Uses targeted change-record mode and re-freezes the live diff before verdict.
assertions: Maps claims to current source/test evidence

evals.prompt: 验证发布说明里“已实现、已测试、兼容”的每个声明是否有当前证据。
evals.expected_output: Reconciles release claims with source, tests, packaging, and compatibility evidence.

evals.prompt: 大重构完成后，审计架构文档、状态表和 README 是否仍反映实际模块边界。
evals.expected_output: Performs a broad post-refactor documentation drift audit.

evals.prompt: 只审查 SRS 的术语、矛盾和验收标准，不核对源码。
evals.expected_output: Routes normative requirements quality to ada-srs-review.

evals.prompt: 根据源码从零写一份新的用户指南。
evals.expected_output: Routes authoring rather than consistency auditing.
assertions: Does not pretend an existing claim set

evals.prompt: 审查 src 的复杂度、重复和安全缺陷，不看文档。
evals.expected_output: Routes source quality analysis to code/project audit Skills.

evals.prompt: 只比较这两版 Markdown 的差异和遗漏。
